Use case: sketch-to-render. Deliver a PRODUCTION 2D skeletal-game sprite on real transparent background, original Chinese xianxia ink-and-wash illustration, native high definition. Image 1 is an EXACT FULL CANVAS placement and silhouette guide, NOT a thumbnail to crop/recenter; Image 2 explains anchor positions; Image 3 is STYLE/COLOR ONLY and must NOT change the silhouette or placement.
Repaint the gray occupied region into new smooth native-HD artwork at precisely the same canvas-relative location and proportions. Convert coarse stepped boundaries to clean flowing handpainted curves within about half a guide pixel step. Keep ALL empty margins at all four sides, do NOT auto-crop or enlarge the subject to fill the canvas. Remove all guide lines, letters, points, grid, and backgrounds; real zero alpha outside the sprite. No glow, no halo, no shadow behind the part, no checkered background.
Style: crisp fine brush contours, restrained paper-grain pigment texture INSIDE the opaque artwork, large pale ink washes defining simple cloth folds, ivory warm white cloth with muted slate-blue/gray-green binding, soft graphite shadows. Clear legible silhouette at small game scale. No photorealism, no 3D rendering, no glossy satin, no metallic decoration, no thick cartoon outlines. Original understated outfit, no copied logo or exact original pattern.
